programs.title: Primal Survivor China
programs.desc: This time, American Hazen Audel will travel through the wild regions of China.He will face further challenges that will test his knowledge, experience, endurance, and ability to survive in difficult conditions.The survival master will first go to Heilongjiang and Yunnan provinces.He is going on a fishing trip, which will become the main course during a great feast.In the hidden valley, he will be tasked with reconciling the members of two warring clans.The next destination is the beautiful Dulong River region in the southwestern part of the country.Together with the inhabitants of this place, he will try to overcome the stormy waters and get through forests full of bears and poisonous snakes.In the mountains you will find valuable herbs and honey guarded by wild bees.Hazen will have to return with supplies that will feed the people of the village and provide them with a decent income.As usual, the explorer will learn traditional techniques from the local people.Viewers will see if he can cope without modern tools and technology.

programs.title: Live Free Or Die 2

programs.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted 2
programs.desc: The famous chef will learn about the cuisine, culture, traditions and history of inhabitants of distant corners of the world.The winner of several Michelin stars goes on exciting expeditions with the passion of an adventurer.To prepare local dishes, you will often need hard-to-find ingredients.To get them, he will even risk encountering poisonous creatures.He will dive, fish and even jump from a helicopter.This time he will travel through the plains of South Africa, the swamps of Louisiana, the Norwegian fjords, Sumatra and the mountains of southern India.It will also come to Tasmania.
